build_resources.rationale: Four serial build/run resource snapshots healthy; each runtime tree sampled near230MiB, available memory near122GiB, load near2; compile budget6 below project20-core budget. New batch is a bounded compile-resource pilot, not an inference of exact peaks.
build_resources.during_batch: Record sampled load/memory/free disk at modest intervals; keep existing guarded worker checks; no simultaneous simulation. If unavailable/contended, fall back to one build, pause new work as required.
build_resources.after_builds: All builds must be successful and verified before serial simulation C1 then C2 then C3; existing max-concurrent=1 lock remains.
